title: SessionClientMessage
description: Websocket message frontend -> backend on /api/sessions/ws, see session-protocol.md. create, join or resume must come first.

create.description: Opens a lobby. Without role, the joiner's wish or a coin decides who defuses first. With skill_id and island_id it is a storey game: the questions come from that skill, topics is ignored. Otherwise topics must not be empty.

topics.description: Ids of the houses (topics) to draw the questions from.

skill_id.description: The storey (skill) to play; it must be unlocked for the island.

island_id.description: The island the storey is played on; both players must be members.

invited.description: The only user who may join; the game is not listed in the lobby.

join.description: Takes the free seat of a waiting game; the roles are dealt and the game waits for both players to send ready. role only counts if the creator picked none.

resume.description: Reconnects with the token from welcome. With last_sequence, missed events are replayed instead of a snapshot.

submit_answer.description: Only the defuser may answer, once per part, in any order.

answer.description: An AnswerSubmission (answer-submission.schema.json) where questionId may be omitted, the part's position (turn) identifies the question.

ready.description: The sender is ready to play. Once both players are, the clock starts and every module is open. Repeated or late ready messages change nothing.
